description.zh: 实例所属地域，您可以调用[DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~)查询。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~) operation to query the region ID of the instance.

title.zh: 查询KMS密钥是否已授权给实例

descriptions.zh: 在调用[ModifyDBInstanceTDE](~~131267~~)接口开启透明数据加密TDE前，请调用本接口查询KMS密钥是否已授权给MongoDB实例。
descriptions.en: Before you enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) by calling the [ModifyDBInstanceTDE](~~131267~~) operation, you can call this operation to check whether KMS keys are authorized to ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds check-cloud-resource-authorized --db-instance-id dds-bp18f7d6b6a70000 --target-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
